messages.text: is anyone from the team available?   I cashed in harlo bolts for a B30 and haven't received an email yet.

Yes, the team is in today, and I'll pass this to them. I can also check whether the redemption made it through as an order.

What's the email on your Harlo pool account, or the one you used when you redeemed? If you got an order number, send that too. Once I have it I'll look for the B30 order, and someone from the team will pick this up and get back to you by email.
I just need the email you used for the redemption so I can find it and pass it on. Can you type it here? If you have an order number, add that too.
Handed to the team · Harlo pool redemption not visible in Shopify; needs a person to trace it.

I couldn't find the B30 under that email, Dan. Your last order with us was in January, so your Harlo bolts redemption hasn't turned into an order on our side yet.

I've sent it to the team with your details. Someone will look into the redemption and email you at (email hidden) If you have a confirmation or screenshot from the Harlo pool side, paste it here and I'll add it to your request.
there was no confirmation or anything from the site.   however my points balance did drop from 7,200,000

Thanks, that helps. A drop in your balance means the redemption went through on the Harlo side, so the team just needs to match it to an order for you. It's all in your request.

What does your balance show now, and roughly when did you redeem? With those two details the team can find the exact transaction faster when they email you.
